title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Mr Blue Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Mr Blue blends rich dark berries with a gentle icy lift for a sweet and refreshing fruit profile. The berry mix delivers depth and smooth sweetness, while the cool finish keeps every draw clean and well-defined. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, each pod and refill combination offers an easy, mess-free way to enjoy powerful flavour performance with no need for refilling or coil changes. The system includes a 2ml prefilled pod and two 10ml auto-refilling e-liquid containers, delivering up to 25,000 puffs of smooth, consistent MTL (mouth-to-lung) vapour. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt formulation provide a balanced throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction with every puff. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
